event.title: The Manifest
event.text:
A Mecha courier frame drifts with its drive burnt out. Its cargo manifest is open to any scanner: parts for one ship, the Vector Frame, the best frame the Mecha have ever built. And parts for something the manifest calls a Mawjig Vector Drive. A drive that folds space, far enough to reach another galaxy.
You pass the manifest to The Colony Ship. The answer comes back at once.
"If the Mecha have a way out, we need it. Find that ship."

outcome.text: You strip the courier's hold before its escort drops out of its jump. Wherever the Vector Frame is, it will be one part short.

choice.text: Repair its drive, for a fee.

outcome.text: The courier pays a fair price and not a bit more. While your crew work, its pilot can't stop boasting: the Vector Frame will be waiting near the rim, and nobody will ever catch it.
You leave the courier where it drifts, and keep the manifest.

event.title: The Ones Who Caught It
event.text: A GATOS hunting squad hangs in pieces across the cluster. They found the Vector Frame before you did. Their last log is still broadcasting, on a loop.

outcome.text: The log ends mid-sentence, but not before it gives the Vector Frame's heading.
There's a lot left to convert. By the time you're done, the log has faded into static.
{crew} studies the scorch marks like a page of code. "Stern beams. It fires while it runs. It always runs." {crew} marks its heading on your charts while your crews salvage what they can.

event.title: The Yard That Built It
event.text:
A Mecha yard boss sees where your squad is headed and laughs.
"The Vector Frame? We fitted half of it. You won't catch it. But if you want to try, its route is for sale. Or you could win it."

outcome.text: The yard boss sends the route and counts the Mawjig twice.
"Now that's a customer!" The yard's frames come for you.

event.title: Fair's Fair
event.text: The yard boss hails you from a burning frame, laughing anyway. "Fair's fair. Here's its route. Good luck catching it."

event.title: Rearguard
event.text:
Mecha frames are holding the lane, left behind to stop anyone following the Vector Frame. Their leader hails you, bored.
"Turn back. Or don't. We were hoping someone would try."

outcome.text: "Finally!" The frames spread out to meet you.
You pass through their line unseen and pick up the Vector Frame's wake on the far side.

event.title: A Signal
event.text: Among the rearguard's wreckage, one frame is still transmitting to the Vector Frame. You trace the signal.

event.title: The Vector Frame
event.text:
The Vector Frame waits at the rim, its drive charging. Its captain hails you, cheerful.
"You followed us all this way? Good. We were hoping for a contest before we leave."
The Colony Ship's warning comes through behind it: "Careful. If that drive is damaged when the ship goes, the drive goes with it."

choice.text: Open fire before the drive is charged.

outcome.text: Your squad fires first. The Vector Frame's escorts scramble to cover it.

choice.text: Give them their contest: your squad against their ship alone.

outcome.text: "Deal!" The escorts pull back to watch, for now. The Vector Frame fires first, of course.

choice.text: Jam the drive before it can jump.

outcome.text: Your probe latches onto the Vector Frame's drive. Whatever happens now, it isn't leaving.

event.title: The Rim
event.text:
The rim is here: the last clusters before the dark between galaxies. The Vector Frame is not.
It was here, though. A fold that size leaves a scar in space, and your sensors can still read which way it bent.

outcome.text: The scar runs along the rim, not out of the galaxy. Wherever the Vector Frame went, it hasn't crossed yet.

event.title: The Vector Frame
event.text:
The Vector Frame is here, still patching the holes you left in it. Its captain hails you, a little less cheerful than last time.
"Again? Good. We weren't finished either."

choice.text: Open fire before its repairs are done.

outcome.text: Your squad fires first, straight into the patches.

choice.text: Jam the drive before it can fold away again.

outcome.text: This time your probe is waiting for the drive. The Vector Frame isn't folding anywhere.
"Deal. Again." The escorts pull back to watch, and this time you know how long that lasts. The Vector Frame fires first, of course.

event.title: The Vector Frame
event.text:
The Vector Frame is here, and it isn't going anywhere. Two folds have spent its drive. It can't charge another.
Its captain hails you, and for the first time doesn't sound cheerful at all. "Fine. No more running. Come and win it, if you can."

outcome.text: Your squad fires first. There's nowhere left for it to go.

choice.text: Offer them their frame for the drive.

outcome.text: A long silence. Then the captain laughs, not happily. "A frame that still flies is worth more than a drive that's spent. Take it." The Mecha cut the Mawjig Vector Drive loose and push it across to you, undamaged.
"Sell it? We'd rather lose it." The Vector Frame's weapons come online.

{crew} lays it out in clipped Mecha code: a spent drive, a frame that still flies, and a squad that will win either way. The captain runs the numbers and gives up. The Mecha cut the Mawjig Vector Drive loose and push it across to you, undamaged.

event.title: The Rim
event.text:
The rim is here, and the Mawjig Vector Drive is in your hold. Out here it's only cargo. Fitted, it could fold space.
Any store can fit it to one of your ships. A refit yard can fit it to The Colony Ship.

choice.text: Turn back and have it fitted.

event.title: The Rim
event.text:
The rim is here: the last clusters before the dark between galaxies. Without the Mawjig Vector Drive, nothing in your squad can cross it.
Behind you, the collapse keeps coming.
